subject: I sent a screenshot of the text
title: I sent a screenshot of the text
preheader: Notes landed in Obsidian, already linked. A daily routine asked if I wanted them on the calendar.
tease: Notes landed in Obsidian, already linked. A daily routine asked if I wanted them on the calendar.

lines: This weekend I'm in a wedding. I sent Claude screenshots of a shop text and a group text. Notes showed up in Obsidian, already linked.
A daily routine asked if I wanted calendar events from those atoms. I said yes.

blocks.text: This weekend I'm in a wedding. Last week the shop texted that the tux was ready, and to come in and try it on so they have time for adjustments.
I sent Claude a screenshot of the text.

blocks.alt: A screenshot of the shop text. The tux is ready.

blocks.text: A note showed up, already linked to Christian. I didn't title it, and I didn't pick a folder.
In August I'd sent a screenshot of a group text the same way. Rehearsal at the church at 4, then dinner.
I have a daily routine that looks at recent atoms and asks if I want anything on the calendar. I run it in Claude. I've run it in ChatGPT too. It asked, and I said yes.
Want to be featured? Reply and show how you use Atoms day to day. We only name people with permission.
